title: Schedule of Exempt Amounts — Grid Access Charges and Expiring Net Energy Metering Credit
content:
Under the Net Energy Metering riders valued at the avoided-cost export rates — Rider NBT-R Residential Net Billing Tariff, Rider NBT-C Commercial Net Billing Tariff and Rider NBT-L Large Customer Net Billing Tariff — an exempt amount of carried credit is spared at the anniversary expiry, sized by the grid access charges booked on the agreement over the past year.

**Rule.** When the rider values exports at the avoided-cost export rates and the grid access charges booked for billing periods ended in the 12 months before the expiry total at least the large-system charge total of 300.00, the exempt amount is the large-system exempt amount of 25.00. When the rider values exports at the avoided-cost export rates and those charges total less than 300.00, it is the small-system exempt amount of 10.00. Under a retail-valued rider no exempt amount applies.

**Records read.** The grid access charges in the agreement's net metering history whose billing periods ended in the 12 months before the expiry.

## Exempt amount

| Rider | Grid access charges of the 12 months | Exempt amount (USD) |
|---|---|---|
| Avoided-cost rider | 300.00 or more | 25.00 |
| Avoided-cost rider | Less than 300.00 | 10.00 |
| Retail-valued rider | Any | None |

## Boundary cases (hypothetical)

- Twelve monthly grid access charges of 25.11 total 301.32: at least 300.00, so 25.00.
- Twelve charges of 24.99 total 299.88: less than 300.00, so 10.00.
- Twelve charges of exactly 25.00 total 300.00: at least 300.00, so 25.00.
